Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of WMT.
We generated $18.4 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2019.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 206 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 10% to 11% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 10% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
